notification: The AI code review of {{target}} is ready

verdictHeadline.match: The pull request implements this ticket
verdictHeadline.partial: The pull request implements part of this ticket
verdictHeadline.mismatch: The pull request does not implement this ticket

criteria.title: Acceptance criteria
criteria.none: No acceptance criteria yet. They tell the AI code review what the pull request must do.
criteria.addPlaceholder: e.g. A wrong password shows an error message
criteria.full: A task can have at most {{max}} acceptance criteria.
criteria.saveError: We could not save the acceptance criteria.

panel.title: AI code review
panel.subtitle: Checks whether the linked pull request really implements this ticket.
panel.unavailable: AI code review is not set up on this server. An administrator must configure the AI provider.
panel.disabled: AI code review is turned off for this workspace.
panel.disabledManage: Turn it on in the workspace settings.
panel.noPr: No pull request is linked yet. Mention {{key}} in a pull request or branch, or paste a pull request address below.
panel.readOnly: You need permission to edit tasks to run a review.
panel.noCriteria: This task has no acceptance criteria, so the review will use the description and the checklist.
panel.loadError: We could not load the AI reviews.
panel.runError: We could not start the review.
panel.empty: No review has been run for this task yet.

progress.running: Reading the pull request and checking each criterion. This can take a minute or two.

failed.title: The review could not be completed

criterion.noEvidence: Nothing in the pull request shows this.

partial.title: Partial review
partial.body: Not all of this pull request could be sent to the model, so the result may miss problems. These files were left out or cut:

meta.automatic: Automatic review of a new commit

settings.title: AI code review
settings.description: An AI agent reads a ticket's pull request and tells you whether it implements the acceptance criteria, with evidence and code issues.
settings.loadError: We could not load the AI code review settings.
settings.saveError: We could not save this setting.
settings.unavailable: No usable AI provider is configured on this server. An administrator must check AI_PROVIDER, AI_API_KEY, AI_BASE_URL and AI_MODEL.

notice.title: Your code is sent to a third party
notice.body: When this is on, the changes of the pull requests you review (the diff) and the ticket text are sent to {{provider}} ({{model}}), an outside processor, to produce the review. Nothing is sent while it is off. Do not turn it on for code that your agreements do not allow to leave.

enable.label: Enable AI code review
enable.description: Lets members with edit permission run a review from a task.

auto.label: Review new commits automatically
auto.description: When a linked pull request is opened, updated or marked ready, a review starts without anyone asking. Each commit is reviewed once.

token.label: GitHub access token (private repositories)
token.help: Optional. A read-only token (Pull requests: read) lets the review read private repositories. It is stored encrypted, only used for repositories your tasks already link to, and never shown again.
token.notSet: No token saved. Public repositories work without one.
token.invalid: That does not look like a GitHub token.

usage.label: Used today
usage.reset: The count restarts at midnight UTC.

problems.PROVIDER_UNKNOWN: AI_PROVIDER is not one of qwen, deepseek, openai, openrouter or custom.
problems.KEY_MISSING: AI_API_KEY is empty (or DASHSCOPE_API_KEY on an existing Qwen installation).
problems.BASE_URL_INVALID: AI_BASE_URL must be an HTTPS address. HTTP is accepted only for localhost with a custom provider.
